==Rewards==
{{Main|Dusuri's Star Shop}}
[[Stardust]] is obtained by mining the [[crashed star]]. Stardust is used as currency at [[Dusuri's Star Shop]] to purchase the [[celestial ring]] along with other rewards.

Experience rates vary greatly based on level, the tier of pickaxe used, and time spent locating stars. If mining consistently with a [[Dragon pickaxe]] and 90+ mining, players can expect approximately 30,000 experience per hour.
